name: BombVault
description: The best and only backup tool you'll ever need for Unraid. One-click backup and full disaster recovery for your Docker containers, VMs, the flash USB and any folders you point it at, powered by restic. The restore is the star: a backed-up container or VM reappears in the Docker or VM tab exactly as before, with no reinstall and no reconfiguration. Incremental, deduplicated and always encrypted, with off-site repos (including immutable, ransomware-resistant append-only copies with tamper verification), retention, file-level restore, restore from another BombVault server, live restore progress and cancel, integrity checks and off-site DR drills, scheduling and pre/post-backup hooks, all configured in the WebUI. A single "Backup Everything" pass covers containers, VMs, flash, folders and BombVault's own config in one run, so one ping afterwards tells you the whole server is protected. Full documentation: https://junkerderprovinz.github.io/bombvault/

paths.name: Config
paths.description: BombVault's own state (SQLite DB, TLS cert, restic cache).

paths.name: Host Data
paths.description: Your Unraid storage root /mnt, which covers the user share and the cache and pool mounts, so any container's appdata is reachable wherever it lives. Backup sources and destinations both live here; pick the exact subpaths in the WebUI under Settings. Read for backup, written on restore. Read/Write - Slave, so a share or disk that mounts after the container starts (e.g. /mnt/remotes at boot) becomes visible without restarting BombVault.

paths.name: Unraid Flash (/boot)
paths.description: The Unraid USB flash, mounted whole. Powers two things: (1) Flash backup (Settings - Domains - Flash) of the entire /boot - Unraid OS, license, array config, shares, network and plugin config; and (2) capturing/restoring a container's Unraid template (under /boot/config/plugins/dockerMan/templates-user) so a restored container reappears as a NORMAL, editable Unraid app instead of a 'third-party' container. Leave at the default. Flash RESTORE never overwrites the live flash - it streams the snapshot to your browser as a ready-to-use .zip for the Unraid USB creator (or any fresh USB).

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Root-equivalent host control: stop/start/recreate containers around backup/restore. Together with the broad /mnt mount this gives BombVault root-equivalent access to your host, so run it only on a trusted, non-exposed network.

ports.name: WebUI Port (HTTPS)
ports.description: The BombVault WebUI (HTTPS, self-signed cert out of the box). This is the port you open.

ports.name: WebUI Port (HTTP)
ports.description: Plain-HTTP port. Only used when HTTP_ONLY is set to true (i.e. behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy). Leave at the default otherwise.

variables.name: HTTP_ONLY
variables.description: Serve plain HTTP instead of HTTPS — only for use behind a TLS-terminating reverse proxy. false = HTTPS (recommended); true = plain HTTP on the HTTP port above. NOTE: when true, the WebUI link still points to HTTPS — open http:// :[PORT:3000]/ instead (or set the container's WebUI to it).

variables.name: APP_KEY
variables.description: REQUIRED. 64 lowercase hex chars: openssl rand -hex 32. Master key for secrets and the derived restic password; losing it makes encrypted backups unrecoverable.

variables.name: HOST_SOURCE_ROOT
variables.description: The HOST path mounted as 'Host Data' (default /mnt). BombVault translates the bind-mount sources Docker reports (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/x) into paths under this mount. Change only if you mounted a different host root than /mnt.

variables.name: BOMBVAULT_SELF_CONTAINER
variables.description: The name of this container, so BombVault never backs up and stops itself. Leave it empty and BombVault finds its own container.

variables.name: BACKUP_MAX_HOURS
variables.description: Maximum wall-clock hours a single backup run may hold its domain lock before it is force-cancelled (a guard so a wedged run cannot block the domain forever). Leave empty for the 48h default. Raise it for very large or slow cloud backups (a run cancelled at the cap fails with 'context deadline exceeded'). Set 0 to disable the cap entirely.

variables.name: VM Backup: Host
variables.description: VM backup only. Set this to your Unraid host's LAN IP (the IP you open the web UI on, e.g. 192.168.x.x) — replace the placeholder. On simple bridge networking you may instead use host.docker.internal. Leave the placeholder if you don't use VM backup.

variables.name: VM Backup: SSH Port
variables.description: VM backup only. Unraid's SSH port. Change only if you changed it from 22.

variables.name: VM Backup: SSH User
variables.description: VM backup only. SSH user on the host. Leave as root.
